target.title: fix(openai): respect api:"openai-completions" config in transport normalization (#99273)
target.body:
Fixes #99273.

## What Problem This Solves

Users setting `api: "openai-completions"` at the provider or per-model level for `openai/*` models were silently ignored. The transport was always forced to `"openai-responses"`, causing every `openai/*` call to hang to idle timeout when the user explicitly configured completions mode.

## Why This Change Was Made

`shouldUseOpenAIResponsesTransport` checked `params.api !== "openai-completions"` when it should have checked `params.api === "openai-completions"`. The inverted condition meant that explicitly setting `api: "openai-completions"` for the `openai` provider fell through to the default URL/provider check and returned `true` (use responses transport), overriding the user's configuration.

## Evidence

**Behavior addressed**: `api: "openai-completions"` config is ignored for `openai/*` models.

**Real environment tested**: Node 22.19+, local OpenClaw checkout.

**Exact steps or command run after this patch**:

```
node --import tsx -e "..."
```

**Evidence after fix**:

```
=== shouldUseOpenAIResponsesTransport (fixed) ===
api                       | provider | baseUrl          | result | expected
(unset)                   | openai   | (default)          | true   | true     ✅
openai-completions        | openai   | (default)          | false  | false    ✅
openai-chatgpt-responses  | openai   | (default)          | true   | true     ✅
openai-completions        | openai   | custom URL         | false  | false    ✅
```

BEFORE fix: api=openai-completions returned true → FORCED responses → hang ❌
AFTER fix:  api=openai-completions returns false → uses completions → OK ✅

```
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/openai/openai-provider.test.ts --run
 Test Files  1 passed (1) / Tests  45 passed (45)

node scripts/run-oxlint.mjs extensions/openai/openai-provider.ts
 (passed, exit 0)
```

**Observed result after fix**: The `shouldUseOpenAIResponsesTransport` function correctly returns `false` when `api: "openai-completions"` is set, preserving the user's configuration. Default behavior (no api set) is unchanged.

**What was not tested**: Live E2E with a real OpenAI endpoint in completions mode. The fix is verified at the transport normalization boundary which is the exact drop point for this regression.

## Root Cause

A single char bug in `shouldUseOpenAIResponsesTransport` (`extensions/openai/openai-provider.ts:462`): `!==` was used instead of `===` when checking for `"openai-completions"`. The condition was intended to short-circuit when the user explicitly requested completions mode, but the inverted operator caused completions to fall through to the default responses path.

## AI Assistance

- **AI-assisted**: Yes
- **Model used**: Claude Opus 4.8 (1M context)
- **Co-Authored-By**: Already in commit message
